blocks.heading: Weak Lines in a Technical Writing Interview
rows: I do not want to code.
Say what you will build with words.
I use AI to write docs.
Say how you verify against the product.

blocks.heading: AI Behind a Technical Writing Answer
rows: Less structured and often lower pay.

blocks.heading: Practice Rounds Before the Interview
rows: A stranger can repeat your story back accurately after one hearing.
Say it aloud under a minute.
You finish in about a minute and it sounds like you, not a script.
Your answer to the question you fear holds up without notes.
You keep the same facts when a follow-up changes the angle. Field check: steady on coding question.
